title: Niners' Kittle targets Week 1, says he's 'on track...

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Niners' Kittle targets Week 1, says he's 'on track...
sources.description: Niners tight end George Kittle said he's "ahead of schedule" in his recovery from a torn right Achilles and believes he's "on track" to return in Week 1 against the Rams.
